subject: Reprovision Penpot MCP 2.13.3 with pnpm 10.28.2
body: Rebuild the local Penpot MCP runtime from the current repository setup script. It is pinned to @penpot/mcp@2.13.3 and pnpm@10.28.2. Return stdout/stderr and success status, including whether http://127.0.0.1:4400/manifest.json becomes available. Do not alter Doré's active model or visual core.
